title: SSE: resume-probe and interleaved function-call serialization fix
author: Asha Patel
description: Motivation: intermittent partial-JSON emissions and out-of-order function-call events were observed in high-throughput hosted streaming sessions, especially when network jitter triggered reconnects or when chunk boundaries split UTF-8 escape sequences. This PR introduces a small, backward-compatible runtime handshake (resume-probe) and a deterministic serializer for interleaved function/tool call events to ensure ordered emission and recoverable partial JSON spans. Changes: 1) resume-probe: on reconnect we emit a compact probe token containing a seq snapshot and last-complete-event boundary; the client can acknowledge and request a resume window or full re-emit, allowing the server to avoid blind replays that caused duplicate delimiters. 2) windowed re-emit: when resume-probe indicates an overlap, the runtime will re-emit only the minimal window anchored at a safe boundary rather than clients seeing truncated JSON fragments. 3) fncall-serializer: function/tool call events are serialized into a length-prefixed subframe when interleaving with text tokens; this removes ambiguity when byte boundaries split JSON and guarantees ordering by attaching an ordinal to each fncall subframe so downstream consumers and OpenAI-compat parsers can deterministically reconstruct call order. 4) utf8-escape-repair: added logic to detect split UTF-8 escape sequences across chunks and coalesce prior to framing decisions, avoiding invalid UTF-8 output in streams. 5) tests and docs: new unit and integration tests for resume/replay scenarios, an e2e harness that simulates jittered chunking, and updated OpenAI-compat notes. Backwards compatibility: server continues to emit legacy events; resume-probe is opt-in via header X-RW-SSE-RESUME and can be enabled per-client. Rollout: gated by feature-flag and gradual cohort rollout for hosted API, dedicated nodes can opt-in via config. Linear references: ENG-1289 for resume probe and ENG-1337 for fncall ordering.

d4e5f6a: implement fncall length-prefixed subframe serializer and ordinal tagging
7a8b9c0: utf8 escape coalescer, tests and e2e jitter harness, docs
review_comments: Connor Lee (2026-02-04): Can we avoid adding a new header by piggybacking resume-probe on the existing session-init frame? Response: decided to keep opt-in header to avoid breaking older clients; added compatibility shim in openai_compat that synthesizes probe when missing.

Priya Desai (2026-02-06): Please add a test that simulates multiple overlapping fncalls with jittered chunk boundaries. Response: added tests/e2e/jitter_harness/test_resume_replay.py which covers overlapping fncalls and verifies ordinal reconstruction.

Evan Zhang (2026-02-07): Concern about metric cardinality from per-probe seq tags. Response: emit probe metrics as low-cardinality histograms and sampled logs; updated pkg/metrics/streaming_metrics.go accordingly.
release_notes: Fixes a class of streaming issues where partial JSON and interleaved function/tool call events could be emitted out of order or with truncated UTF-8 escapes. Adds an opt-in resume handshake and deterministic fncall serialization to improve client-side reconstructions. No breaking API changes; opt-in via X-RW-SSE-RESUME header.
testing_and_metrics: Added unit tests for serializer invariants, integration tests for reconnect/resume flows, and an e2e harness that simulates 0-200ms jitter and dropped chunks. Benchmarked on dedicated staging: tail-latency unchanged, median CPU +2% when resume-probe enabled; added sampling to keep cost low. Metrics validate no increase in duplicate-event rate after rollout.
rollback_plan: Feature-flag disabled immediately reverts resume behavior. If an unexpected regression is observed, revert the feature-flag and deploy a hotfix that strips probe headers for affected cohorts. CI includes a blocking smoke-run that must pass before cohort expansion.
